utterances.speaker: anna
utterances.text: Good morning everyone. Let us start with the release plan for next month.

utterances.speaker: ben
utterances.text: The payment integration is almost done. I still need two days to finish the tests.

utterances.speaker: carl
utterances.text: Then we can announce the launch to the customers on the fifteenth.

utterances.speaker: anna
utterances.text: Agreed. Ben, please share the test report on Thursday, and Carl will prepare the announcement.

utterances.speaker: ben
utterances.text: Will do. I will also update the pricing page before the launch.

utterances.speaker: carl
utterances.text: Good. One more thing, we should talk to the biggest customer before we change their contract.

utterances.speaker: anna
utterances.text: I will call them tomorrow. That is everything for today, thank you all.
